start.scope: Make unchanged Class-A controls cheaper through fresh safe parsing, invocation-local reuse and exact source slicing. Do not reduce populations, waive failures, cache stale evidence across runs, parallelize mutation tests, or change assertions to pass.

baseline.note: 3113 recorded keys are not 3113 separately executed nodes. Summing parameterized aggregate durations with their child rows is not wall time.

profile.method: One read-only normal backlog.load then backlog.lint under cProfile; no pytest or gate run.
profile.note: Instrumented timing identifies mechanisms; it is not a fair full-run before/after benchmark.

findings: Registry and fingerprint paths repeatedly use pure-Python YAML parsing despite an installed safe C parser.
One lint invocation repeatedly parses and walks the same proof source file for distinct acceptance references.
The source-sweep index invokes ast.get_source_segment for each test function, repeatedly splitting its entire module.

changes: tools/_documents.py uses the installed CSafeLoader or SafeLoader fallback on fresh supplied input; it never caches a file, parsed result, or evidence verdict.

backlog, blueprint, plan_view and four direct blueprint test readers use the shared safe parser. The evidence owner adopted the same helper for both fingerprint YAML inputs; hash framing, field selection and evidence binding remain unchanged.
backlog.lint shares parsed function-name sets within exactly one invocation, including build-rule references; the next lint observes changed, removed, malformed or restored proof files again.

tools/_source.py indexes UTF8 source lines once per observed module, preserving AST byte offsets and CR/LF/CRLF rather than treating form-feed or Unicode separators as source line breaks. The two existing source sweep readers retain their populations and assertions.

new_control_population.historical_owner_status: Originally authored without delegated execution; root subsequently coordinated verification.

build.static_check: Ruff passed all 13 files owned in this repair. No pytest or gate was run by this author.
build.compatibility_limits: Safe decoder errors retain PyYAML's error hierarchy; C and Python parser wording is not asserted byte-identical. Existing source scanners request unpadded segments, the exact mode implemented and checked here.

verification.gate: SCOPED BUILD PASS -- FULL GATE RED; only TRACE-C1/P24 remains.

comparison.limits: Measured runs on this machine, not a controlled benchmark or guarantee. Original failed and intermediate optimized observations remain preserved. No whole-packet acceptance follows.

cumulative.remaining_failure: Concurrent upload barrier timeout, subsequently diagnosed as path containment refusal; no gate stamp or evidence promotion.
